title: Extract the duplicated learnerProfiles FK-guard full-table-scan shared by three append-only mergers
why: The identical 3-line 'load every learner_profiles row into a Set to guard an FK' snippet is copy-pasted across three mergers, each re-running the full scan once per merge() call. Harmless at today's family-sized profile counts, but three independent copies will silently diverge if the guard logic ever needs to change (e.g. excluding soft-deleted profiles).
recommendation: Extract a shared `Future<Set<int>> existingProfileIds()` helper (on UserDatabase or a small mixin) and call it from all three mergers.
acceptance_criteria: One shared helper exists with its own unit test; the three call sites use it with no behavior change (existing points_sync_merger_test.dart and learning_ledger_merger_test.dart continue to pass).
